description: Base health insurance recommendation needs used by the Recommendation Context Engine.

high_sum_insured.description: Need for a larger health insurance cover to protect against high hospitalization costs.
high_sum_insured.customer_friendly_description: A higher cover can help reduce out-of-pocket expenses during major hospitalization.
high_sum_insured.advisor_explanation: Important where medical costs, family size, lifestyle, income level, or city of residence justify higher protection.
high_sum_insured.risk_caution: Higher sum insured may increase premium. Affordability should be checked.
high_sum_insured.compliance_note: Recommendation should be based on customer affordability and documented protection need.

maternity_or_newborn.description: Need for maternity, delivery, and newborn-related benefits.
maternity_or_newborn.customer_friendly_description: Useful if you are planning a family or may need maternity and newborn-related support.
maternity_or_newborn.advisor_explanation: Highly relevant for married couples planning children. Waiting periods and benefit limits must be checked carefully.
maternity_or_newborn.risk_caution: Maternity benefits usually have waiting periods, sub-limits, and eligibility conditions.
maternity_or_newborn.compliance_note: Do not imply immediate maternity coverage unless waiting period and conditions are verified.

wellness.description: Need for wellness, preventive health, health rewards, or wellness-linked benefits.
wellness.customer_friendly_description: Wellness benefits may reward healthy behavior or support preventive care.
wellness.advisor_explanation: Useful for health-conscious customers and families interested in preventive care and long-term engagement.
wellness.risk_caution: Wellness benefits should not be treated as a substitute for core hospitalization coverage.
wellness.compliance_note: Wellness rewards and discounts should be explained as per policy terms.

low_waiting_period.description: Need for shorter waiting periods for pre-existing disease, specified disease, maternity, or initial coverage.
low_waiting_period.customer_friendly_description: Lower waiting periods can help you access certain benefits sooner.
low_waiting_period.advisor_explanation: Important for customers with existing health conditions, family planning needs, or urgency around coverage usability.
low_waiting_period.risk_caution: Waiting period comparison must be based on exact policy wording and benefit context.
low_waiting_period.compliance_note: Do not claim coverage is immediately available unless explicitly supported by evidence.

avoid_copay.description: Need to avoid mandatory co-payment during claims.
avoid_copay.customer_friendly_description: A plan with no or lower co-pay may reduce your share of claim expenses.
avoid_copay.advisor_explanation: Especially important for senior citizens, customers with higher claim probability, or customers who want predictable out-of-pocket cost.
avoid_copay.risk_caution: Co-pay may vary by age, zone, claim type, room category, or network rules.
avoid_copay.compliance_note: Co-pay interpretation must be verified against policy wording.

room_rent_flexibility.description: Need for flexible room rent eligibility or fewer room category restrictions.
room_rent_flexibility.customer_friendly_description: Room rent flexibility may help you choose better hospital rooms without proportionate deductions.
room_rent_flexibility.advisor_explanation: Important in metro cities and higher-cost hospitals where room category can affect total claim payout.
room_rent_flexibility.risk_caution: Room rent limits may trigger proportionate deductions depending on policy terms.
room_rent_flexibility.compliance_note: Room rent claims impact should be explained carefully and evidence-backed.
